scope.acceptance: Audit correctness only; no fairness, viability, human feel or competitive balance acceptance.
scope.cycle_ticks: Same-wire minimum startup plus release-owned cooldown; not sustainable resource-limited throughput.
scope.identical_stat_groups: Seven applied stats only; NOT identical full kits, body geometry or air capability.
scope.recipe_damage: Resolved base pulse_damage only; quantity, strength, exposure, eligibility and special effects still apply.
scope.same_delivery_groups: Identical compiled delivery excluding element only; chemistry is NOT equivalent.
scope.units: Flux/Health/Stamina and distances use milli-units; ratios use permille. Named ms/ticks fields retain their units; matter/capacity keep recipe-specific units.
